info.title: Multi-Model Computer Vision API
info.description:
Multi-model computer vision API serving image classification, object detection,
and batch inference.

## Authentication

Exchange an API key for a bearer token at `POST /api/v1/auth/token`, then send
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request.

## Rate limits

Applied per user tier and reported in `X-RateLimit-Limit` and
`X-RateLimit-Remaining` on every response. A rejected request returns 429 with
`Retry-After`.

| Tier | Requests / minute |
| --- | --- |
| free | 10 |
| pro | 120 |
| enterprise | 1200 |

## Correlation

Every response carries `X-Correlation-ID`. Supply your own to have it adopted;
quote it when reporting a problem.

post.summary: Exchange an API key for an access token
post.description:
Exchange a long-lived API key for a short-lived bearer token.

The token carries the caller's tier, which determines their rate limit.
Short lifetimes mean a leaked token stops working on its own, without
needing the underlying key to be rotated.

Classify a single image and return ranked predictions.

Requires a bearer token. Rate limits apply per user tier and are reported
in the ``X-RateLimit-*`` response headers.

post.description:
Detect objects and return labelled bounding boxes.

Boxes are in absolute pixel coordinates of the uploaded image, so a client
can overlay them without knowing how the image was resized internally.

Returns 503 rather than 404 when no detector is deployed: a caller must be
able to distinguish "not available here" from "wrong URL".

503.description: Detection model not deployed in this environment

post.description:
Retrieve the most similar indexed images, ranked by cosine similarity.

Results are *semantically* similar rather than visually near-duplicate: the
embeddings come from a classification backbone, which collapses intra-class
variation by design. Two different photographs of the same subject will rank
as highly similar.

parameters.name: min_similarity

schema.description: Discard results below this cosine similarity.
schema.title: Min Similarity

parameters.description: Discard results below this cosine similarity.

503.description: Similarity index not built in this environment

Queue images for background processing.

Returns 202 with a job ID immediately; the work happens in a Celery worker.
Poll ``status_url`` for progress and results.

Distinguishes ``degraded`` from ``unhealthy`` deliberately. If the cache is
down but models still serve, the service is usable and must stay in the
load balancer; reporting that as unhealthy would take down a working

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the image to process.

item_id.title: Item Id
item_id.description: Caller-supplied identifier, echoed back in results.

BatchItem.title: BatchItem
BatchItem.description:
One image in a batch request.

Images are supplied as URLs rather than inline base64. Base64 inflates the
payload by a third and forces the whole batch into memory at once; URLs let
the worker fetch lazily and keep the submitting request small.

BatchItemResult.title: BatchItemResult
BatchItemResult.description:
Outcome for one item in a batch.

Carries either ``result`` or ``error``, never both. One bad image must not
fail an otherwise successful batch, so failures are reported per item.

status_url.title: Status Url
status_url.description: Poll this URL for progress and results.

BatchJobResponse.title: BatchJobResponse
BatchJobResponse.description: Acknowledgement of a submitted batch job.

results.title: Results

BatchJobStatusResponse.title: BatchJobStatusResponse
BatchJobStatusResponse.description: Progress and, once finished, results of a batch job.

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: Optional URL notified with the result when the job finishes.

BatchRequest.title: BatchRequest
BatchRequest.description: Submit images for asynchronous batch processing.

file.title: File
file.description: Image to classify (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or BMP).

BoundingBox.title: BoundingBox
BoundingBox.description:
Axis-aligned box in absolute pixel coordinates of the original image.

Absolute rather than normalised coordinates: callers overlay these on the
image they uploaded, and normalised values would require every client to
know and reapply the original dimensions.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of ranked predictions to return.

confidence_threshold.title: Confidence Threshold
confidence_threshold.description: Discard detections scoring below this threshold.

max_detections.title: Max Detections
max_detections.description: Cap on returned detections, highest scoring first.

DetectionResponse.title: DetectionResponse
DetectionResponse.description: Result of a single-image object detection.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description:
Aggregate service health.

``status`` is ``healthy``, ``degraded``, or ``unhealthy``. The middle state
matters operationally: if the cache is down but models still serve, the
service is usable and should not be removed from the load balancer, but the
condition must still be visible.
